paper_title: Emission of Single and Few Electrons in XENON1T and Limits on Light Dark Matter
notes: Paper sets 90% CL limits on multiple light DM models including DM-electron scattering, electric/magnetic dipole, anapole, dark photons (absorption), ALPs, and solar dark photons. The hint suggests DarkPhoton and the paper explicitly highlights excluding new parameter space for dark photons and solar dark photons. However, no numerical limit values for the kinetic mixing chi are present in the provided text (figures 15 and 16 referenced but data tables not included). Could not extract any (mass, coupling) data points. Note the paper also constrains ALPs (g_ae) so coupling type is somewhat ambiguous, but dark photon is the headline bosonic result. Default DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed for halo dark photons; solar dark photon limit uses solar flux not local density. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Dark photon kinetic mixing limit from Figure 15 (top panel).
